question: Would Everton beat Crystal Palace at full time (90 minutes + injury time)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official final score of the Everton vs Crystal Palace Premier League match (22 August 2026) shows Everton with more goals than Crystal Palace at the end of 90 minutes of regulation play (including injury time).
- "Draw": Wins if the official final score shows Everton and Crystal Palace level on goals at the end of 90 minutes of regulation play (including injury time).
- "No": Wins if the official final score shows Crystal Palace with more goals than Everton at the end of 90 minutes of regulation play (including injury time).

Clarifications:
- This is a Premier League fixture; extra time is not played in regular-season Premier League matches. The result is determined solely by the score at the end of 90 minutes plus referee-added injury time. Any reference to "extra time" in the market question is disregarded.
